english: Five English records produced valid JSON; the irrelevant record mislabeled absence as incorrect and was rejected by quote validation.
russian: All six Russian records began a quote with the correct Cyrillic text, then the constrained decoder repeated whitespace until the token limit and left invalid JSON.
diagnosis: The schema-constrained decoder is unreliable when the model must copy arbitrary Cyrillic text.
replacement: Pre-segment each answer as S1, S2, and so on. The judge selects an ASCII segment ID; code restores the exact original quote.
